stem.text: Which feature of some xerophytic leaves reduces the rate of transpiration by decreasing the water potential gradient between the internal leaf surface and the atmosphere?

A.text: a thick waxy cuticle on the upper surface of the leaf

B.text: leaves reduced to spines with a small surface area to volume ratio

C.text: stomata located in sunken pits on the leaf surface

D.text: elongated leaves that are swollen storing large amounts of water
